cards.headline: Risk factors for poor prognosis in neonatal sepsis: a systematic review and meta-analysis

source.title: Risk factors for poor prognosis in neonatal sepsis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Elevated inflammatory biomarkers, hematologic abnormalities, hyperlactatemia, hypoalbuminemia, and Gram-negative bacterial infection are important indicators of poor prognosis in neonatal sepsis. Early recognition of these factors and timely intervention may improve clinical outcomes.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence techniques applied to anxiety disorders recognition

source.title: Artificial intelligence techniques applied to anxiety disorders recognition: a systematic review.
source.excerpt: This review highlights the critical role of AI in optimizing the detection and treatment of anxiety disorders. It offers a current and detailed overview of advancements in this field, making it a key resource for researchers, healthcare professionals, and technology developers aiming to integrate AI into mental health practices.

source.title: Air-France-Flug 4590
source.excerpt: Auf dem Flug 4590 der Air France verunglückte am 25. Juli 2000 bei Gonesse eine vollbesetzte Concorde kurz nach dem Start vom Flughafen Paris-Charles de Gaulle. Alle 109 Insassen sowie vier Personen am Boden kamen ums Leben, eine weitere Person am Boden wurde schwer verletzt. Es war der einzige Absturz einer Concorde.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in virtual fracture clinics

source.title: Artificial intelligence in virtual fracture clinics: a systematic review of imaging and clinical-text tools.
source.publisher: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
source.excerpt: VFCs require the integration of information from imaging and patient records. Multiple image interpretation tools are available with high performance in fracture identification. The development and integration of NLP tools to interpret clinical documentation from emergency departments and urgent care centers are necessary for AI-VFC.

cards.headline: Effect of mind-body therapies on anxiety, depression and sleep quality in college students

source.title: Effect of mind-body therapies on anxiety, depression and sleep quality in college students: a network meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: The current evidence indicates that Qigong is the optimal intervention for alleviating depression and improving sleep quality, whereas yoga is the most effective intervention for alleviating anxiety. Nevertheless, due to the limited number of studies included, further research is needed to enhance the reliability of the findings.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in the Assessment of Males with Chronic Pelvic Pain Syndrome

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in the Assessment of Males with Chronic Pelvic Pain Syndrome: An Up-to-Date UPOINTS-Based Narrative Mapping Review.
source.excerpt: AI has promising potential to improve differential diagnosis, multidomain phenotyping, and individualized management in males with CPPS. Current evidence is mainly translational and hypothesis-generating.
